bio: In classic settings embellished with many plants and customised by the porphyry floor, while in warm weather we move to the outdoor area overlooking the splendid Piazza Dante, in any case they serve Maremma cuisine of excellent fragrance and based on impeccable raw material, both fish (our suggestion goes for the steamed catch of the day with vegetables and freshly made mayonnaise) and meat. Next door, Osteria Canapino offers a more streamlined and informal cuisine....
